Description: Freeze content and media editing in the Umbraco backoffice during deployments, migrations and uSync imports. Schedule a freeze from your CI/CD pipeline, warn editors with a countdown, and let it expire automatically. Add-ons freeze Umbraco Forms, Umbraco Commerce and Umbraco AI too, and hold back Hangfire jobs until the freeze ends.

RelatedPackages.Description: Also freezes Umbraco Forms in the backoffice. Website form submissions keep working.
Also freezes Umbraco Commerce settings. Orders, carts, checkout and payments keep working.
Also freezes the Umbraco AI configuration. Using AI keeps working.
Holds back Hangfire jobs until the freeze ends.

Title: Content Freeze
